entries.zh: 叩见：俯首屈身行礼以示敬意（向尊长叩拜求见）
entries.en: to pay a visit with an obeisance; to bow head and whole body in reverence

entries.zh: 叩拜：叩首跪拜，行大礼致敬
entries.en: to kowtow and bow in worship; to pay reverence with the head lowered

entries.zh: 俯：俯首低头；俯身
entries.en: to lower/bow the head; to bend forward

entries.zh: 俯仰：低头与仰视（俯首抬望）；引申一举一动、举止
entries.en: to lower the head and look up; (fig.) one's movements and bearing

entries.zh: 叩谢：叩首致谢（向尊长叩拜谢恩）
entries.en: to kowtow in gratitude; to thank a superior with a reverent bow

entries.zh: 顿：顿首叩头，以首触地行礼
entries.en: to knock the head against the ground in reverence (as in the obeisance 顿首)

entries.zh: 顿首拜：顿首叩拜——叩头至地的大礼
entries.en: to kowtow head to the ground and bow; the full obeisance 顿首拜

entries.zh: 踩倒：踩踏使其倒下；绊倒（踩石而跌）
entries.en: to tread down / knock over by stepping; to stumble and fall over stones
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（採/踩），官话栏调号污损（T99），西文 'y grime' 一词难解；据音写 chây-tò 与西义'踏石跌倒'暂定踩倒义。

entries.zh: 和息：息讼和解，争执（官司）私下了结
entries.en: to settle a quarrel or lawsuit amicably; to make peace and drop the complaint

entries.zh: 放下：放下、放开；使下来（如放孩子们下来去吃饭）
entries.en: to put down; to let go / set free (as in: let the children go off to eat)

entries.zh: 横：横置、横挂（横着；如黑披风横垂之状）
entries.en: crosswise, horizontal; to lay or hang across (like a hanging drape, e.g. a black cloak)
entries.notes: 西文词组语法残乱（'Baxarla boca la colgadura'），据汉字'横'与音写 huànn/hêng 定横置义。

entries.zh: 扳落来：拉扳下来（如把树枝扳低）
entries.en: to pull/bend it down (as one draws down a tree branch)
entries.notes: 汉字'枋'疑为'扳'；依西义'如树枝拉下'与音写 pâng/pān-lò-lâi 暂定。

entries.zh: 扯落来：拉扯下来（边扶持边拉下）
entries.en: to pull it down while holding/supporting it
entries.notes: 汉字'撦'疑为'撆'；'撦'即'扯'，依西义'持扶而降'与音写 chê-lò-lâi 暂定。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: '落梢'非通行词，字存疑（梢/稍未定）且两栏第二调号均污损（T99）；西义仅示'于险处自鞍/椅下地'，不敢臆定。

entries.zh: 下手：动手、着手做某事；搭手帮忙
entries.en: to set one's hand to a task; to set about; to lend a hand

entries.zh: 减多了：减去许多（价钱已减很多）
entries.en: much reduced; the price has come down considerably

entries.zh: 下：低、在下；向下
entries.en: low, below; downward

entries.zh: 低：低（高度或身份之低）；（银钱）成色低、低劣
entries.en: low (in height, rank or morals); of inferior grade/fineness (as silver below standard)
entries.notes: 西文后半残乱（'quilates ue plata' 似涉银两成色），M 栏 'guē Tap.' 后一词不明；主义'低'据汉字与官话 tī 确定。

entries.zh: 卑：卑下（地位低微；德性卑劣）
entries.en: lowly, base; humble or mean in rank or morals

entries.zh: 卑贱：身份低贱，为人鄙劣
entries.en: lowly and base; of vile, mean status (a worthless man)

entries.zh: 卑下：卑贱低下（人品鄙劣可鄙）
entries.en: lowly, abject (of a vile, contemptible man)
entries.notes: M 栏混入西语残词（troatenia 等）且调号污损（T99）；核心义据汉字'卑下'、官话 pŷ-hiâ 与西义'鄙劣之人'暂定，余文存疑。
